categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent manufacturing and smart logistics, offering integrated solutions including intelligent production systems, intelligent logistics warehousing systems, and intelligent automated parking systems. These segments cover planning consulting, software development, intelligent equipment design and manufacturing, system integration, installation, and after-sales services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include IoT-based real-time data acquisition and edge computing, AI-driven scheduling and control algorithms, digital twin systems using Unity3D engine, multi-level S-curve motion control, and advanced robotics such as AGV with laser SLAM and vision navigation. Production methods emphasize customized, large-scale, non-standard equipment manufacturing with modular design, supported by in-house software and hardware development capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span automotive manufacturers (including Mercedes-Benz, Audi, BMW, BYD), new energy battery producers (CATL, Envision Power), steel and metallurgy companies (Baowu Steel), pharmaceutical firms (Sinopharm, CR Pharma), consumer goods, e-commerce, cold chain logistics, and petrochemical industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and projects are concentrated in China with production bases in Shanxi, Jiangsu, and Shanghai. Internationally, the company has established subsidiaries and projects in Malaysia, the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Australia, Poland, Russia, Japan, Thailand, Iran, and Iraq, with a strategic focus on Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent equipment and system solutions for manufacturing and logistics processes. It designs, manufactures, and integrates automation equipment and software systems, serving as a system integrator and solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening domestic market leadership, accelerating international expansion, and deepening technological innovation. R&D focuses on intelligent hardware, AI, industrial internet, digital twin technology, 5G+ industrial internet integration, and green low-carbon logistics solutions. The company collaborates with universities and research institutes to advance core technologies such as AGV navigation, digital twin platforms, and intelligent scheduling.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of intelligent production systems, logistics warehousing systems, and automated parking systems. The company follows a project-based sales model with contract pricing typically determined by competitive bidding and cost-plus margin. Payment terms include advance payments, progress payments upon delivery, final acceptance payments, and warranty retention.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic intelligent logistics equipment supplier with strong system integration capabilities and rich project experience. It competes in sectors such as automotive manufacturing, new energy, steel, pharmaceuticals, and e-commerce logistics. It holds a competitive edge through comprehensive software and hardware integration, extensive patent portfolio, and international project delivery capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 807 million, a 7.41% decrease year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 257 million. Despite the loss, cash flow from operating activities improved by 65.19%. The company has total assets of around RMB 3 billion and continues to invest in R&D with expenditures exceeding RMB 49 million, representing over 6% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive intelligent manufacturing and logistics solutions integrating advanced automation, AI, and digital twin technologies. Its unique value lies in customized, high-quality system integration capabilities, strong R&D innovation, and a full product ecosystem covering software and hardware. The company also highlights its green low-carbon technology innovations and international delivery experience as key differentiators.
